text: Figure 4.2: Overview of Implicit synchronization In this case, RAM Block is mapped to one SW-C and sharing of RAM block is not recommendable. Whenever SW-C accesses NVRAM using RAM block (temporary / permanent), it has to ensure the data consistency of the RAM block until ongoing operation is completed by the NvM. Following steps need to be considered while using Implicit synchronization. • Write request: 1. The application fills a RAM block with the data that has to be written by the NvM module
